docs.summary: A mesh uploaded to a geometry page. Its id is dense and stable for its life, and it draws nothing until its data is resident on the GPU.
Dense id, unique among live meshes of the renderer.
Bounds of the data last given, which may not be resident yet.

Whether the mesh's data has been placed on the GPU and can draw. A renderable switched to a mesh that is not resident yet draws nothing until it is, so swap meshes once this is true to avoid a blank frame. Any thread.

Where a resident mesh's vertex streams live, for a compute pass writing its [`GpuStreams`](#api~Prowl.Graphite.Rendering.MeshData~GpuStreams). False until the mesh is resident. A new [`Placement`](#api~Prowl.Graphite.Rendering.GpuMeshStorage~Placement) means the mesh moved and its GPU streams have to be written again. Render thread, such as in a RenderProvider's Compute.
Replaces the mesh's data, keeping its id. Thread safe, the upload happens on a later frame.

docs.summary: Overwrites one vertex stream in place and keeps everything else, for data that changes often while the shape stays. The stream must exist and match the vertex count of the data last given, otherwise the write is dropped. Thread safe, the upload happens on a later frame.
Frees the mesh's geometry once the GPU no longer uses it.
